principle: Trust is a feature. Precision must degrade gracefully as video evidence degrades.

gates.outcome: Below configured threshold: suppress fine distal-joint/racket-face claims; retain coarse footwork/court-position analysis if usable.
Below 60 fps: label high-speed racket velocity and contact micro-timing as lower-confidence; use intervals and relative comparisons.
Suppress racket-face and precise racket-head claims when blur is excessive.
Use visibility masks; do not interpolate through long occlusions for diagnosis.
Without stable calibration, suppress meter-based court distances and use body-normalized/image-plane comparisons.
A metric may be valid in one view and invalid in another; gate per metric, not per whole video.
Monocular 3D and especially velocity estimates require conservative uncertainty unless the model is validated/fine-tuned for athletic movement.

confidence_propagation.event: combine detector agreement, track quality and temporal resolution
confidence_propagation.metric: combine input-track confidence, event confidence, view suitability, calibration and smoothing sensitivity
confidence_propagation.construct: use weakest-critical-input principle plus multi-rep consistency
confidence_propagation.insight: combine construct confidence, context match, recurrence, outcome link and counterexample rate
confidence_propagation.visual: never render a more precise-looking overlay than the evidence supports
